title: Canonical Authored Course Model V1.3

acceptance_criteria.text: Public canonical package types faithfully represent the authored Course, activity union, blocks, rubrics, lectures, academic catalog, instructor profile, and labs.
Unknown authored semantic enums and activity/block variants reject without fallback projection.
Public package runtime reconstructs authored definitions without lossy defaults, while learner/runtime state remains separate.
Neutral public fixtures and package parity tests cover the V1.3 loss regressions and privacy boundary.

source: Canonical Authored Course Model V1.3 request.
